name: io.github.oscardvs/zoteus
description: The everything Zotero MCP server — Web API v3 + desktop local API: search, safe writes, attachments, citations, semantic search, and a scholarly-context graph.

environment_variables.name: ZOTERO_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Zotero API key (writes/sync/groups; optional for local-only reads).

environment_variables.name: ZOTEUS_LOCAL
environment_variables.description: Use the Zotero desktop local API: auto | on | off.

environment_variables.name: ZOTEUS_ALLOW_DELETE
environment_variables.description: Set to true to enable permanent deletion (off by default).
